title: Spillage reported up the chain, told to go away, file deleted

tellings.quote: he basically recommended to me, delete that and pretend he never saw it, and then he just left the room.

plain: Matthew Brown, who describes himself as a Pentagon whistleblower, says that in 2018 he reported a "spillage", meaning secret material turning up somewhere it should not be, to the office that oversees the Pentagon's most tightly restricted programmes. He says the material was a capabilities briefing on something called Immaculate Constellation, and that the official he reported it to "basically recommended to me, delete that and pretend he never saw it, and then he just left the room." Brown tells it first-hand, as a sign that such material is being kept out of sight on purpose.
